events.text: P: Hi. The train station, please. D: No problem. Just so you know, there are road works on the main avenue today, so I'll take the side streets. It's a small detour, but we get to the same place. P: Oh, okay. No problem, thanks for telling me.
P: Is it much longer this way? D: Two more minutes, that's all. We're nearly back on the main road. P: Perfect, thank you.
